description:
Goal
Make pattern-dispatch reachability preserve the set-theoretic correlation of original input types through every supported tuple/list/map projection, then reuse that one calculator for semantic clause reachability and exhaustiveness.

Root defect
The failed fz-1ah.1 prototype converted each ContractArrow parameter Ty into a parallel KnownSubjectDomain tree, then stored one independent domain per projected SubjectId. Refining a tuple field or list head detached it from the originating union, so sibling projections invented impossible cross-products. Boundary-lifting patches moved the loss around: tuple siblings improved, tuple->list->head lost correlation. The pre-existing semantic reachable_clause_ids has the same defect: HashMap<SubjectId, Ty> plus apply_evidence refining projected subjects independently; its EdgeEvidence proof loop is a no-op.

Production signal
A source-level choose/1 returning {:a,:x}|{:b,:y}, followed by a classifier with those two exact clauses plus a wildcard, currently infers the wildcard :fallback as reachable. reachable_clause_ids controls return unions, callsite discovery, executable demand, materialization, and body pruning, so under-approximation can delete required code while over-approximation warms phantom work.

Authoritative model
- World.types is the sole owner of the compiler-local Types store; Ty handles never cross worlds.
- FunctionContract arrows retain correlated parameter Ty rows.
- PatternDispatchPlan retains original input subjects, complete PatternSubjectRef projection paths, predicates, and branch-local EdgeEvidence.
- Types owns intersection, difference, tuple/list/map construction and projection, and emptiness.

North Star placement
Build one compiler2-owned pure calculator that borrows &mut Types and settled PatternDispatchPlan<Ty>/root Ty rows. It must not retain &World, introduce another type/domain store, create a fact family or scheduler, or perform a second fixpoint. Contract-aware diagnostics must later consume settled FunctionDefined/FunctionContract/EntryDispatch facts without making DefineFunction wait on FunctionContract, which would create a dependency cycle. Lazy runtime demand must remain intact.

Strategy
Represent traversal state only at original input roots, one correlated input row at a time. For a predicate on a projected subject:
1. interpret only an exactly representable Region as a Ty constraint at that subject;
2. lift the constraint back through the complete PatternSubjectRef path to the original input root;
3. match edge = intersect(root, lifted constraint); miss edge = difference(root, lifted constraint);
4. prune only when the refined root is empty;
5. derive every later projection fresh from the refined root, never from detached child slots.
Memoize by (GraphNodeId, canonical root Ty row), not node alone, and keep results deterministic. Unknown guards, bitstrings, pinned/value-only equality, unsupported map keys, and non-representable inverse projections keep both branches. Numeric/string equality cannot use widened kind types to prune misses. Observing one list position must not globally constrain other positions of a homogeneous list. No telemetry is needed for traversal statistics.

Unification/removal
Replace compiler2/jobs/semantic.rs reachable_clause_ids/collect_reachable_outcomes/branch_possible/apply_evidence with the calculator. Keep DispatchMatrix generic and domain-free. Do not keep generalized KnownSubjectDomain algebra, tuple-boundary heuristics, or a second diagnostics traversal. fz-1ah.1 will later use this calculator and remove the old test-only helper.

TDD
Use production Types/PatternDispatchPlan/semantic paths to pin:
- {:a,:x}|{:b,:y} exact clauses exclude cross-wired and wildcard outcomes;
- {:a,[true]}|{:b,[false]} preserves correlation through tuple->list->head;
- nested tuples and list-of-tuples preserve supported correlation;
- observing one list head does not correlate independent later list positions;
- unknown guards and value-only predicates remain conservative;
- overload arrows are evaluated as correlated rows without cross-arrow products;
- a wide 16-field decision chain visits bounded (node, root-row) state and keeps root slots equal to input count rather than projection count.

Acceptance
- Correlation is preserved across arbitrary exactly supported projection chains without Cartesian materialization.
- Semantic reachable clauses use the shared calculator; fz-1ah.1 can consume the same result for exhaustiveness.
- Unsupported predicates are conservative, never unsound.
- No retained World lifetime, duplicate type model, parallel fixpoint, or new durable fact family.
- Docs state root-authority and list-position invariants.
- Tests and clippy pass warning-free.
title: Preserve root type correlation through dispatch projections
